register.body: Thank you for joining {{wbstname}}, the intelligent agriculture platform. Please confirm your registration by entering the security code below on the verification page.
register.expiry: This code is valid for {{expiryMinutes}} minutes. If it expires, you can request a new one here.
register.ignore: If you did not sign up, please ignore this email. For any concerns, contact technical support.

forgot.title: Password Reset Request
forgot.body: We received a request to reset the password for your {{wbstname}} account. Click the button below to set up a new password.
forgot.expiry: This single-use link is valid for {{expiryHours}} hour(s). After that, you will need to submit a new request.
forgot.ignore: If you did not request a password reset, please ignore this message. Your account remains secure. For assistance, contact technical support.

request.title: New Verification Code
request.body: You requested a new verification code for your {{wbstname}} account. Use the code below on the verification page.
request.expiry: This code is valid for {{expiryMinutes}} minutes.
request.ignore: If you didn't request a new code, you can safely ignore this email. For help, contact technical support.

verified.title: Account Verified Successfully
verified.body: Your account has been authenticated. You now have full access to our intelligent agriculture platform.
verified.body2: Monitor your fields, analyze crop data, and make informed decisions directly from your dashboard.

oauth_verified.title: Account Created Successfully
oauth_verified.body: Your account was successfully generated using {{provider}}. You are now securely logged in and ready to explore our agricultural platform.
oauth_verified.body2: Access your dashboard to track crop health and analyze trends in real time.

reseted.title: Password Updated Successfully
reseted.body: Your {{wbstname}} account password has been successfully modified. You can now log in using your new credentials.
reseted.security_body: If you did not authorize this change, please contact our support team immediately.
